messages:
maria: Heads-up — console editor is offering an autofix that reorders header lists when the YAML uses anchors/merges. It changes semantics in a few routing configs I tried :thinking_face:

kevin: Seen this. The linter's canonicalization step sorts header blocks, which flips precedence when merged via anchors.

sasha: Can you paste a minimal repro? will try locally :eyes: 

maria: ```yaml
route:
  match:
    path: /v1/search
    headers:
      <<: *defaults
      x-tenant: exact:acme

# anchor defined elsewhere
defaults: &defaults
  - name: x-tenant
    value: regex:^acct-.*
``` 

maria: Saving from the interactive builder applies the autofix and the diff shows reordering, which breaks our test harness on roundtrip.

tim: That's bad — UI autofix should be idempotent. If it changes canonical order we should either not apply it automatically or show an explicit preview and require confirmation.

kevin: Agreed. Two fixes: (1) make the console autofix a 'suggestion' reversible via a 'show diff' modal, (2) add an authoring CI test to ensure autofix is idempotent for anchor/merge cases.

maria: I can craft the failing config and a test case.

sasha: Also suggest adding a small fuzz target that randomly inserts anchors + merges into header lists and asserts roundtrip equality after linting. That should catch regressions.

deploy-bot: Created ticket PLAT-4821: "route-editor: don't auto-apply header-list canonicalization on save; preserve anchor/merge semantics" (assignee: kevin)

kevin: I'll own the console change, will open WIP PR with the modal preview. ETA EOD tomorrow. :+1:

 tim: I'll add the fuzz target to config-authoring CI; might take a day.

maria: I'll open the test PR and include the minimal YAML plus reproduction steps.

sasha: Nice. Once PRs land we should run a quick canary on a small tenant set to ensure no unexpected behavior.

maria: Sounds good. Thanks all. :smile:
